title: NVus: World of Wonder
description: An expansive modpack that adds a ton of new features, QoL improvements, automation/machinery, magic, spells, world generation, beautiful shaders and resourcepacks, optmizations etc.
body:
![Main Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3db726e07a13f810ccb544fed3dbc1a295843897.png)

This modpack adds a vast array of additions and improvements to the base game!
- Several World Generators working together
- Automation/Machinery
- Magic Wands, Spells & spellbooks.
- New food items, animals, butchering
- New crops types and farming abilities
- Explosive addition of new biomes, structures, enemies etc.
- New dimensions like the classic Aether & all related items, mobs etc
- Optimizations
- QoL Improvements
- Controller Support [Optional]

Checkout my plugins: [CLICK HERE](https://modrinth.com/user/never2nv/plugins)
